title: Mitigating Gender Bias in Code Large Language Models via Model Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluates bias using a custom dataset (CodeGenBias) and a proposed metric called Factual Bias Score (FB-Score). The methodology measures the absolute difference between the LLM's predicted probability of generating the gendered pronouns 'he' and 'she' for a given profession and the actual real-world gender distribution baseline for that profession.
